news.headline: a16z brings growth fund to $8.5B days after launching new $1.1B fund
news.summary: a16z is doubling down on growth-stage investing, closing an $8.5B fund just days after launching a separate $1.1B fund. The dual closures signal the firm's confidence in its ability to deploy capital at scale across its portfolio companies.

news.headline: Sequoia-incubated Empirik launches with $21M to predict outages before they happen
news.summary: Empirik, a Sequoia-backed startup, just launched with $21M to predict infrastructure outages before they happen—bringing the same AI-driven approach that Cursor brought to coding. The bet: AI that anticipates IT failures could save enterprises massive downtime costs and headaches.

educational.title: What Actually Happens When You Buy a Stock
points: You're buying a tiny slice of real ownership in a company, not a lottery ticket
Your broker matches your order with a seller through an exchange in milliseconds
Stock price moves on collective belief about future profits, not just today's news
You make money two ways: the price rising, or dividends paid out over time
Owning one share still makes you a part-owner, with voting rights and all
